title: Insurance Coverage Standards
description: Synthetic insurance minimums for Acme Corp's operational risk profile.

requirements.title: Cyber incident coverage
requirements.requirement: An IT-dependent company that processes customer data must maintain cyber incident coverage for ransomware, breach response, privacy notification, forensic investigation, and business interruption caused by cyber events.
expected_evidence: Cyber liability or cyber incident coverage

requirements.title: Technology errors and omissions coverage
requirements.requirement: The company should maintain technology errors and omissions coverage for software service failures and customer contractual claims.

requirements.title: General liability coverage
requirements.requirement: The company should maintain general liability coverage for ordinary business operations.

sections.title: Insurance review overview
sections.content: This synthetic standard is designed to flag the absence of cyber incident coverage in Acme Corp's current insurance policy.
